presentation.name: Sharpen a request before the agent starts work
presentation.summary: On your command, rewrites a request with what the project already answers, asks only what it cannot infer, and starts once you confirm.
benefits: Fills targets, conventions and checks from the repository instead of asking you
Searches the web only when the request depends on an outside fact, such as a version's breaking changes, and cites primary sources
Asks only the questions whose answers change the work, in one round
Shows the rewritten request and waits for your go before starting
Runs only when you call it, so clear requests are never slowed down
